---
id: vunl-forget-it-adf0c7fd
pattern:
  - "$.change(function() { forgetitoptions.forget_save_options(); })"
message: Vulnerable call to forgetitoptions.forget_save_options() detected
severity: ERROR
languages:
  - javascript
metadata:
  cwe: CWE-835 (Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop'))
  cvss: 7.5
  description: Vulnerability in forgetitoptions.forget_save_options() function
    can cause an infinite loop and denial of service attack.
  remediation: Update the code to use a valid exit condition for the loop.
